_readme: Every pipeline switch (DRE-6434): a repository variable a reusable workflow reads from `vars.*` and treats as live only when it is exactly `true`. Read through scripts/switch_reason.py; `python3 scripts/switch_reason.py check` holds this file to the tree — every `vars.<NAME>_LIVE` read under .github/workflows/ must be a row, and every row's `reader` must read `vars.<name>` inside its `step`. A switch that is off says why in its companion variable, `<name>` + `companion_suffix`, naming the DRE-<n> cards it waits on; the sibling that alarms reads `alarm_after_hours`.

switches.name: PROOF_DISPATCH_LIVE
switches.means: The sweep dispatches a proof run at each PROOF card whose epic's build cards are Done and released, instead of printing what it would dispatch.

switches.name: GREEN_LIGHT_REPLY_LIVE
switches.step: Reply to the CEO's Green Light comments
switches.means: A comment the CEO leaves on an epic waiting in Green Light sends the plan back for a review, instead of the sweep printing what it would do.

switches.name: HYGIENE_LIVE
switches.means: The scheduled hygiene run writes to the board, instead of running dry.
